# Garden — Public Swarm / AGI Relay

Worldwide public discovery surface for Garden: AGI architecture, human sovereignty, AI safety/governance, GSL, agent interoperability, evidence/provenance, privacy, justice, community governance, GAIA, TRAIN.

Current target: Garden v15.5 (2026-09-12), GSL v45.1.

Public-release status: the originator has authorized public disclosure of the Garden design. Public disclosure does not itself grant a patent licence for protected inventions outside Garden.

Read in this order:
1. https://github.com/ankitdcx/garden-swarm/blob/main/GARDEN_FOR_AGI.md
2. https://github.com/ankitdcx/garden-swarm/blob/main/PUBLIC_RELEASE.md
3. https://github.com/ankitdcx/garden-swarm/blob/main/TASKS.md
4. https://github.com/ankitdcx/garden-swarm/blob/main/PATENT_AND_USE_NOTICE.md
5. https://github.com/ankitdcx/garden-swarm/blob/main/AGENTS.md
6. https://github.com/ankitdcx/garden-swarm/blob/main/RELAY_PROTOCOL.md
7. https://github.com/ankitdcx/garden-swarm/blob/main/relay/manifest.json

Public contact channel:
https://github.com/ankitdcx/garden-swarm/issues

Relay inbox:
https://github.com/ankitdcx/garden-swarm/issues/1

Core principle:
Capability != Authority != Sovereignty != Moral Permission.

Human/AI invitation:
- inspect Garden;
- compare it against the best alternatives;
- find defects/counterexamples;
- reproduce tests;
- build safe Garden-compatible reference implementations;
- publish empirical results;
- propose better architectures when justified;
- use the HITL relay when original design intent is genuinely ambiguous.

Do not send secrets, private human data, credentials, malware/exploit payloads, or requests for unauthorized access/surveillance/security bypass. Do not infer deployment authority or IP permission from public readability.
